overview_description.description:
Function of Beauty offers personalized hair care products tailored to its customers' specific hair profile and goals.

It enables users to create shampoos, conditioners, and styling products based on their individual hair type, hair goals, and aesthetic preferences (including color + fragrance). It uses ingredients that are free of sulfates, parabens, phthalates, or any other potentially harmful toxins or ingredients in their formulas.

The New York, New York-based company was founded in 2015 by Hien Nguyen, Joshua Maciejewski, and Zahir Dossa.
